What is the cell membrane's property that controls entry and exit?
questions.a: Selective permeability - it allows some substances (water, small molecules) through while blocking others.

questions.q: What is diffusion across a cell membrane?
questions.a: Movement of a substance from where it is more concentrated to where it is less, through the membrane.

questions.q: How does osmosis differ from diffusion?
questions.a: Osmosis is specifically the movement of water through a semipermeable membrane from lower to higher solute concentration.
